title: Implement Game UI Overlay and Integration
description: Create onscreen UI overlays for the start screen, live score display, game over screen with final score, high score table, and restart button, fully integrated with the game loop.
acceptanceCriteria: UI displays current score during gameplay and shows game over summary overlay upon death
Restart button successfully resets game state, player, and pipes
Unit tests confirm UI DOM element interactions and state bindings
reviewFeedback: The UIManager implementation correctly handles all required DOM overlays, live scoring, start/game-over transitions, high score table rendering, and event binding. All unit tests pass successfully, adhering to modular architecture and clean code principles.
